facts.fact: The Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] is applied through SI 155 of 2024, which took effect in September 2024 and made a Data Controller Licence mandatory for organisations processing personal data.

POTRAZ is designated Zimbabwe's Data Protection Authority under Section 5 of the Act and its Director General signed Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026 (published 2026-08-12; date of the notice itself 2026-07-15).

POTRAZ issued Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026 announcing mandatory risk-based compliance inspections of data controllers from 1 September 2026 across nine priority sectors, and runs data controller licensing.

systems.tiers: public and private organisations processing personal data
